reasoning_quality_informational.v1_root_problem: Dispute tickets roughly doubled from ~600/month (Jun-Jul 2026) to ~1180-1260/month (Aug-Sep 2026) (E-03). A majority of disputed bills (1785 of 3025, 59%) were generated from ACTUAL meter reads rather than estimate substitutions (E-02), which rules out missed-read estimate substitution as the primary driver and points to an error introduced into billing import validation processing of actual reads starting around August (H-RULES-CHANGE) as the dominant causal mechanism; a tariff rate change (ruled out by E-04, corroborated by E-06) and slow ticket response (ruled out by E-05, within the 3.0-day SLA) are not the cause.
